reviews.title: Week 1: launch and co-pilot
reviews.headline: Market Monitor rebuilt into a reliable monitoring and research system; the Dashboard now opens with what the plan says is due this week, and a backtest found no edge in the swing rules.
points: All 22 scheduled checks ran on time, within 20 seconds of each slot
New: index scanner, track record, Trends and Reviews pages, crash watch, and a plan-this-week panel
Takeover-pinned stocks (DCC, Intertek, easyJet) are now excluded from swing setups
One-year swing backtest: +0.04R per trade vs +0.10R for random entry, so the recommendation is paper only for now
Daily research-and-build sessions start on Monday 2 November
